preservation.rule: Keep every inherited blob and mode, including all original C# and Rust source/test files. Add 26 PR51-only files unchanged and the new adapter only. No deletion, rewrites, or unrelated evidence imports.

api.entry: FileJob::new() -> (FileJob, Cancellation); FileJob::run(self, Request<'_>, observer) -> Report<E>
api.request: Explicit input Path, output parent Path, single output OsStr leaf, and three native Limits. No archive-derived destination names, global path state, UI, CLI, server or public product entry point.
sequence: Call native snapshot::capture once. On failure return Outcome::SnapshotFailed with the original snapshot::Failure<E>, including original cause and usage.
Retain private snapshot identity/SHA256 observations. Consume its owned Vec into a Box<[u8]> without reopening the source pathname.
Construct one gzip::Budget and call gzip::read once with selected=true. Native single-member header, DEFLATE, CRC32, ISIZE and exact EOF validation must all return successfully before publication.
Return original gzip::Error<E> on decode failure; preserve budget.usage() even when the final failed charge followed the last checkpoint.
Require selected output and its length to match native boundary.inflated_bytes. Adapter invariant failures have their own typed variants and never call publication.
Borrow precisely the validated owned output Vec to the original one-shot publication::Publication::publish. Return its entire native Report<E> unchanged.
api.observations: SnapshotObservation and GzipObservation have private fields and no public constructor/Default/Deserialize. They are in-process observations, not authorization tokens or worker evidence. Snapshot SHA256 covers compressed captured bytes; GZip boundary CRC32 is not an output cryptographic hash.
api.callbacks: Checkpoint { event: native Snapshot/Decode/Publication checkpoint, usage: three native cumulative counters }. Caller Stop::Callback(E) retains E without formatting/boxing or replacement by a later cancellation/deadline. Stop::Cancelled maps to the reached native stage's cancellation. No synthetic postcommit/final observer callback.
api.receipts: No product Published state or job-wide success boolean. Outcome::Publication can contain NotCommitted, CommitUncertain or Committed with native durability and cleanup kept separate. Native private file receipt proves only observed file-layer commit.

budgets.policy: One consumed FileJob, one call per native stage, no retries, no refunds or resets within a stage. Preserve each original accounting algorithm and units. A future caller creating a new job must aggregate retries externally; this API does not implement a retry/shared cross-job budget.
budgets.ledger: Usage { snapshot: snapshot::Usage, gzip: gzip::Usage, publication: publication::Usage }. Zero counters for unreached stages; outcome and optional observations distinguish reach/completion. Each field is copied from the native final report or owned Budget after its stage, including failures; do not sum unlike counters.

snapshot.mechanism: Native reserve-before-read through capture plus compare pass; actual and compared bytes remain separate.

gzip.mechanism: Same owned native Budget across header, inflate, output, CRC/size/trailing checks. Existing clamp-to-hard-cap semantics remain unchanged; input size is per invocation.

publication.mechanism: Native write/read/EOF reservation and actual transfer counters, sync/link/close accounting unchanged.

budgets.memory: At handoff, captured input is at most 16 MiB and selected output at most 16 MiB, plus native bounded scratch/backend allocations. No extra Vec clone; Vec::into_boxed_slice may shrink/reallocate through the standard infallible allocator. Native try_reserve failures remain typed; allocator abort/panic, callback allocations, kernel/filesystem memory and process RSS are not fully bounded.
budgets.elapsed: Native per-stage clock starts on entry to that stage. No single whole-job deadline or hard syscall/callback/allocator cutoff. Postcommit sync and close are never interrupted or relabelled by elapsed/cancellation. Defaults sum to 360 seconds of cooperative stage limits, not a hard wall-clock promise.

cancellation.identity: Every FileJob owns the original one-shot Publication gate from construction. All Cancellation clones refer to that gate and one private AtomicBool.
cancellation.order: Cancellation::request first calls the original native CAS decision. Only Requested/AlreadyRequested sets the front-stage accepted flag; original Requested/AlreadyRequested/TooLate/Finished is returned unchanged.
cancellation.early: Snapshot/decode observers run first to preserve original callback cause, then poll accepted cancellation. A racing accepted request may propagate after another cooperative checkpoint; publication's native gate was already cancelled and cannot commit.
cancellation.commit: Original Pending->Cancelled versus Pending->Committing CAS remains authoritative. No new observer runs after native begin_commit. TooLate or Finished does not set a new cancellation flag or rewrite native outcomes.
cancellation.termination: Dropping an unused Publication marks its gate Finished per original API; this is not proof of rollback, file cleanup, worker exit or cancellation as the returned cause.
cancellation.observer_stop: Observer Stop::Cancelled is a local native stage stop, not an extra call to Cancellation::request. Original callback errors can win over a simultaneously accepted cancellation.

filesystem.behavior: Reuse frozen Linux snapshot and single-file publication as implemented. Parent dirfd, O_TMPFILE, procfs linkat no-clobber, trusted parent and ext-family/XFS checks remain native. No weak fallback or overwrite.
filesystem.names: Caller chooses explicit parent/leaf. GZip FNAME/FCOMMENT is never interpreted as a path, extension, command, or output name.
filesystem.uncertainty: All native non-EEXIST link failures remain CommitUncertain; no automatic retry, unlink, rollback or claim that the target is absent. Successful link with failed parent sync remains Committed with ParentSyncFailed. Every original close failure remains in Cleanup.
filesystem.limits: No original pathname persistence, coherent/atomic input snapshot, inotify history, output contents hash, durable physical deletion or crash-recovery proof.
filesystem.other_os: No Windows implementation or substitute adapter. Reached native unsupported-platform errors are preserved.

dependencies.external: Exactly the 11 existing locked registry packages; selected native features unchanged, no new registry version, process launcher, async runtime, UI or network dependency.
dependencies.ownership: No inherited Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, API, shared type or production source changed.
dependencies.audit: Cache archive/SHA256 and 661 regular source files plus license bytes checked. Current advisory audit not performed; no vulnerability-free claim.

completed: Rustfmt syntax/format check on new source only
not_completed: New module execution or end-to-end regression
execution_boundary.future_review: Fix this source/manifest/remote head before separate compile/run authorization. Regression code belongs only in root tests/. Existing parent test evidence is not a run of this adapter.
